narrative:
Butler County has 248,537 registered voters, with 12.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 27.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 53.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 26.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 26.2% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -1.0% D−R vs -24.1% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
